Her distinct career detail is a successful exit from 'Nova Analytics' – a data visualization company she founded in her late 20s – which was acquired by a larger firm five years ago. This exit provides her with both capital and credibility. We help businesses proactively identify and mitigate disruptions, optimize inventory levels, and reduce operational costs. Having previously built and successfully exited Nova Analytics, I bring a unique blend of technical expertise, business acumen, and a deep understanding of the challenges facing rapidly scaling technology companies. I’m passionate about building high-performing teams and leveraging data to drive tangible business outcomes.
